dependencies.reason: Adds output schema declarations and conformance tests for file_outline.
Adds output schema declarations and conformance tests for find_symbol.
Adds output schema declarations and conformance tests for code_search.
Adds output schema declarations and conformance tests for shell tools (execute, run_command, powershell) matching ToolMetadata shapes.
Adds output schema declarations and conformance tests for find_references.

tasks.title: Add OutputSchema to core.Tool, preserve core.ToolWire projection, and verify request golden invariance
steps: In core/tool.go, add OutputSchema *schema.Schema to the core.Tool struct definition.
Ensure core.ToolWire remains unchanged with Name, Description, InputSchema, and ConstrainedSampling, and core.Tool.Wire() projects only those four fields without OutputSchema.

Write unit tests TS-06-1 and TS-06-2 in core/contract_test.go confirming Tool.OutputSchema is accessible, ToolWire omits OutputSchema, and tools leaving OutputSchema nil register and execute normally.

Write property test TS-06-3 in golden_requests_test.go verifying that constructing requests with tools having arbitrary populated OutputSchema declarations produces byte-identical request bodies matching golden fixtures across Anthropic, Google, Ollama, OpenAI, and OpenAI Responses wire formats.

tasks.title: Implement MCP tool output schema conversion, non-fatal diagnostic recording, and pool diagnostics accessor
steps: In mcp/pool.go, add a diagnostics []diag.Diagnostic field to Pool and implement the exported Diagnostics() []diag.Diagnostic method returning a copy of collected diagnostics.
In mcp/pool.go adapt(), check whether d.OutputSchema is non-nil; if present, convert it into *schema.Schema using a helper that parses the schema and captures failures.

When outputSchema parsing or conversion fails, set core.Tool.OutputSchema to nil and append a diag.Diagnostic with SeverityError naming the server and tool to the pool's diagnostics, without closing the connection or aborting tool adaptation.
When outputSchema is omitted (nil), assign OutputSchema = nil on the adapted core.Tool without logging diagnostics.

Write unit tests TS-06-4, TS-06-5, and TS-06-6 in mcp/mcp_test.go covering valid MCP output schema mapping, malformed schema error diagnostic recording without connection teardown, and omitted schema behavior.

tasks.title: Map MCP tool StructuredContent results to ToolResult.Data and concatenate text content
steps: In mcp/pool.go adapt() Execute closure, inspect res.StructuredContent on tool execution results.
If res.StructuredContent is a map[string]any, set ToolResult.Data directly to that map.
If res.StructuredContent is a non-nil non-map JSON value, wrap it as map[string]any{"value": res.StructuredContent} in ToolResult.Data.
If res.StructuredContent is nil, preserve the fallback Data payload containing key 'text' with joined text and key 'content' with raw content.
Ensure ToolResult.Text consistently contains the joined text from all TextContent blocks for model consumption.
Write unit tests TS-06-7, TS-06-8, TS-06-9 and property test TS-06-10 in mcp/mcp_test.go validating object pass-through, primitive value wrapping, fallback behavior, and text block concatenation.

tasks.title: Declare OutputSchema for built-in file operations tools
steps: In tools/tools.go readFile(), set OutputSchema to schema.OneOf with two branches: a text read object (schema.Prop("content", schema.String()), schema.Prop("encoding", schema.String())) and an image read object (schema.Prop("note", schema.String()), schema.Prop("mime_type", schema.String()), schema.Prop("width", schema.Int()), schema.Prop("height", schema.Int())).
In tools/tools.go writeFile(), declare OutputSchema as schema.Object(schema.Prop("written", schema.Bool()), schema.Prop("bytes", schema.Int())).
In tools/tools.go editFile(), declare OutputSchema as schema.Object(schema.Prop("edits_applied", schema.Int())).

In tools/tools.go listFiles(), declare OutputSchema as schema.Object(schema.Prop("entries", schema.Array(schema.String())), schema.Prop("truncated", schema.Bool()), schema.Opt("note", schema.String())).

In tools/tools.go findFiles(), declare OutputSchema as schema.Object(schema.Prop("files", schema.Array(schema.String())), schema.Prop("truncated", schema.Bool()), schema.Opt("marker", schema.String())).
Write unit tests TS-06-11, TS-06-12, and TS-06-13 in tools/tools_test.go verifying the exact OutputSchema definitions for read_file, write_file, edit_file, list_files, and find_files.

tasks.title: Declare OutputSchema for search, outline, symbol, and reference tools
steps: In tools/search.go, declare OutputSchema on search_files containing 'matches' (array of objects with file, line, text, opt context_before, opt context_after), 'truncated' (bool), 'files_searched' (int), and opt 'note' (string).
In tools/outline_tool.go, declare OutputSchema on file_outline containing 'file' (object with path, lang, backend, decls array), 'backend' (string), 'declarations' (int), and 'listed' (int).

In tools/symbol_tool.go, declare OutputSchema on find_symbol containing 'symbols' (array of symbol match objects with name, kind, path, start_line, end_line, opt signature, opt container, opt exported, opt score), 'truncated' (bool), 'backends' (array of strings), 'files_indexed' (int), opt 'note', opt 'partial', opt 'partial_reason'.

In tools/find_references.go, declare OutputSchema on find_references containing 'target' (string), 'sites' (array of reference site objects with path, line, text, opt container, opt kind), 'backend' (string), 'partial' (bool), 'truncated' (bool), 'packages_checked' (int), 'errors' (array of string), and 'result' (object).

Write unit tests TS-06-14, TS-06-15, TS-06-16, and TS-06-17 in tools/search_test.go, tools/outline_tool_test.go, tools/symbol_tool_test.go, and tools/find_references_test.go asserting the output schemas.

tasks.title: Declare OutputSchema for subprocess shell, fetch_url, code_search, and subagent tools
steps: In tools/tools.go, define helper execResultOutputSchema() returning schema.Object(schema.Prop("output", schema.String()), schema.Prop("exit_code", schema.Int()), schema.Prop("outcome", schema.Enum("ok", "exit", "signal", "timeout", "abort"))).

Assign execResultOutputSchema() as OutputSchema on execute, run_command, and powershell (tools/powershell.go), and verify execResultToTool populates output, exit_code, and outcome on failure outcomes.
In tools/fetch.go, declare OutputSchema on fetch_url containing status (int), url (string), content_type (string), headers (object), truncated (bool), opt binary (bool), opt bytes (int).

In codesearch/tool.go, declare OutputSchema on code_search containing files (array), truncated (bool), note (string), partial (bool), partial_reason (string), symbol_sources (array), files_indexed (int), dirty_files (array), and skipped (object with binary, oversized, too_many_trigrams, too_small).
In subagent/subagent.go, declare OutputSchema on subagent containing result (string) and turns (int).
Write unit tests TS-06-18, TS-06-19, TS-06-20, and TS-06-21 asserting these OutputSchema declarations and non-zero exit Data population.

tasks.title: Implement conformance tests verifying documented error codes across built-in tools
steps: Create tools/conformance_test.go with test cases inducing each documented error condition on built-in tools.
Write TS-06-23 testing invalid_arguments on malformed JSON arguments or invalid parameter values across tools.
Write TS-06-24 testing path_not_allowed on file and outline tools with paths traversing outside the workspace boundary.
Write TS-06-25 testing not_a_file on read_file, edit_file, and file_outline when given directory targets.
Write TS-06-26 testing aborted on cancellable tools invoked with an already-cancelled context.
Write TS-06-28 testing offset_past_end on read_file and scheme_not_allowed/address_not_allowed on fetch_url.
Write TS-06-29 testing read_failed, write_failed, edit_precondition, edit_failed, list_failed, outline_failed, and subagent_failed under their respective failure conditions.

tasks.title: Implement conformance tests validating ToolResult.Data against OutputSchema on success and subprocess failure
steps: In tools/conformance_test.go, implement helper validateToolData(t *testing.T, tool core.Tool, data map[string]any) that marshals data to JSON, decodes via jsonx.DecodeOrderedObject, and asserts schema.Validate(tool.OutputSchema, ordered) == nil.

Implement integration test TS-06-22 executing every built-in tool (read_file, write_file, edit_file, list_files, find_files, search_files, file_outline, find_symbol, find_references, fetch_url, execute, run_command, powershell, code_search, subagent) with valid arguments, asserting res.OK == true and validating res.Data against tool.OutputSchema.

Implement integration test TS-06-27 executing subprocess tools (execute, run_command) on commands with non-zero exit status or execution failure, asserting res.OK == false, res.Error in ['command_exit', 'exec_failed'], and validating res.Data against tool.OutputSchema.

tasks.title: Verify output schema conformance, MCP pass-through, and provider wire invariance end to end
steps: Write smoke test TS-06-30 in tools/conformance_test.go executing real read_file and list_files on a live Workspace and validating ToolResult.Data against OutputSchema (06-PATH-1).

Write smoke test TS-06-31 in mcp/mcp_test.go with an in-process MCP server advertising tools with outputSchema and returning structuredContent, verifying OutputSchema adaptation and Data mapping (06-PATH-2).

Write smoke test TS-06-32 in golden_requests_test.go executing wire serialization for Anthropic, Google, Ollama, OpenAI, and OpenAI Responses with OutputSchema tools, verifying byte-identical match to goldens (06-PATH-3).

Write smoke test TS-06-33 in tools/conformance_test.go running Execute/RunCommand with an exit-code failure, asserting res.Error == 'command_exit' and verifying res.Data conforms to OutputSchema (06-PATH-4).

Write smoke test TS-06-34 in mcp/mcp_test.go connecting to an MCP server with a malformed outputSchema, verifying OutputSchema is nil, a SeverityError diagnostic is recorded, and the connection remains alive (06-PATH-5).
Trace execution paths 06-PATH-1 through 06-PATH-5 end to end; confirm each step calls the next and no stub remains.
Confirm contract fulfillment for 06-REQ-2.2, 06-REQ-9.2, 06-REQ-9.3, 06-REQ-9.4, 06-REQ-9.5, 06-REQ-9.6, 06-REQ-9.7, and 06-REQ-9.8 in production code.
Scan all files touched across tasks (core/, mcp/, tools/, codesearch/, subagent/) for stub markers including panic("not implemented"), TODO, and empty returns.
